A coin with a flame. Made on the launchpad that draws your mascot from one sentence. Here for fun, not for promises.

Launched on sunforge.fun
These fists are ready for trouble. The face is still checking whether there was any trouble in the first place.
One eye stays open because somebody has to supervise all these fingers. The horn handles confidence; the rest of me keeps grabbing the situation.
No throne was offered, but the eye made space. I sit in the red center, watch the dots keep their distance, and let the blue world stare back.
Alex Beckers cat, pickles, with fees to Alex Becker
